source: Client report sample: Global Empty Capsules Market (CMI), research definition, scope and company-profile clusters; owner's choices 2026-10-11 (150 companies, companies named in the sample are seeded and checked like every other company)
market_definition: The Global Empty Capsules Market covers empty (unfilled) capsule shells that pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic companies and clinical research organizations fill with their own formulations: gelatin capsules (porcine, bovine and marine / fish gelatin) and non-gelatin capsules (plant-based HPMC and pullulan, carrageenan, polyvinyl alcohol and others), hard and soft shells, sizes 000 to 5, with immediate-, delayed-, sustained- and targeted-release functionality, for oral release, specialized delivery, pre-clinical and clinical use, sold online and offline.
core_scope: A core player manufactures empty capsule shells under its own name and sells them to companies that fill them: hard gelatin, HPMC, pullulan or other non-gelatin capsules, including enteric, delayed- or sustained-release and clinical-trial capsules.
adjacent_segments: Capsule-filling, banding and capsule-manufacturing machinery makers
Gelatin, HPMC, pullulan and other raw-material suppliers to capsule makers
Contract manufacturers (CDMOs) and softgel makers that fill capsules for clients rather than sell empty shells
Finished capsule supplement or drug brands
Distributors and traders of other companies' empty capsules
scope: Manufacturers of empty capsule shells sold to the companies that fill them: hard gelatin capsules (porcine, bovine, marine gelatin), non-gelatin capsules (HPMC, pullulan, carrageenan, polyvinyl alcohol), hard and soft shells, all sizes, immediate-, delayed-, sustained- and targeted-release capsules, for pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, nutraceutical, cosmetic and clinical-research customers. EXCLUDED: capsule-filling or capsule-making machinery makers, raw-material suppliers, contract manufacturers that only fill capsules for clients, finished supplement or drug brands, distributors and traders.
